title: Wallet transport: DIDComm/TSP translator (IO)
description:
Approved design (Mark 2026-10-31): mirror the push-proxy model.
- New serviceType wallet-transport. Relay-designated translator (relay manifest, agreement with the relay) or CO-designated (Space state walletTransport, agreement with the CO, receives only that CO's channel tokens).
- Translator carries live-stream messages (spec 11.4) over DIDComm v2 or TSP unchanged; wallet signs every Publish; translator holds no keys, plaintext, or membership.
- KeyPackages/Welcomes stay on HTTPS KeyPackageEndpoint; history stays on relay sync API.
- Wallet SHOULD use a pairwise DID per translator (not MUST); budget entry states the linkage if it does not.
- Wallet's own mediator = user's network, outside budget, accepted limit.
Files: profiles/wallet-transport.md (new), ARCHITECTURE 2.3/5/6.1, spec/03-spaces.md, spec/11-transport.md, spec/99-appendices.md, README.md, profiles/dtg-openvtc.md 9.
close_reason: Specified as core spec/11-transport.md §11.9 Wallet Transport (not a profile: it defines protocol). serviceType wallet-transport; relay-designated (manifest walletTransport, capability wallet-transport-v1, agreement with each CO holding a relay agreement) or CO-designated (Space state walletTransport). WTOpen/WTFrame/WTClose over DIDComm v2 (type urn:agora:type:WalletTransport) or TSP; WebSocket upstream; seq ordering incl. close; wallet transport answers AdmissionChallenge; no PushRegister through it; connectionLogRetentionDays binds all carried traffic. Pairwise DID MUST (Mark 2026-10-31, changed from SHOULD after review: S1/§11.6). Mediator = user's network. Limits recorded: forged relay messages (confirm failover Errors directly), per-address throttling, connection count. ARCHITECTURE 2.3 row, 5 item 10, 6.1; 03-spaces, 10-relays, 99-appendices, dtg-openvtc 9 updated. Pre-existing gap not fixed: pushProxy/walletTransport absent from 10.2.1 manifest schema.
